notes.title: Twisted Tower - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uO9dIaOo3-c;full][/previewyoutube]

We at 3D Realms are proud to announce a cooperation with Thomas Brush of Atmos Games to publish Twisted Tower. 

Check out our announce trailer for Twisted Tower: climb the Twisted Tower game show! Every twisting floor has a variety of paths to choose, horrifying enemies to slaughter, and clues about your dark past.
